summary: Custom-icon state of a character-creation session; written by DefinitionCommandProcessor::ProcessCommands (macOS), reset to 0/0 by bg3.exe+0x201FC80 when a definition is (re)initialised.

fields.name: field_0
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x201A420 writes 0 (4-byte store); bg3.exe+0x201FC80 writes 0 (4 bytes). Same shape as IconVersion (uint32) + HasIcon (uint8) of eoc::character_creation::CompanionDefinitionComponent (SE CharacterCreation.h) - a guess only. Second pass: bg3.exe+0x201FC80 lines 179-181 fetch the component through the creator bg3.exe+0x201A420 and store `*(undefined4*)p = 0` and `*(undefined1*)(p+4) = 0` - one 4-byte and one 1-byte member, nothing else written.

fields.name: field_4
fields.evidence: Creator and bg3.exe+0x201FC80 write 0 as a single byte at +4.

open_questions: Meaning and names of both members (no reader that uses the values was found on Windows: bg3.exe+0x2020010 removes the component, bg3.exe+0x2076EA0 / 0x208E300 only build views).
second_pass: Widths and offsets confirmed on Windows: the creator bg3.exe+0x201A420 and the definition reset bg3.exe+0x201FC80 write exactly a uint32 at +0 and a byte at +4; registry size 8. Names remain unknown.
